text:
And thou shalt say in that day: I will give thanks to thee, O Lord, for thou hast been angry with me, but thy wrath is turned away, and thou hast comforted me.
Behold, God is my saviour; I will deal confidently, and will not fear: because the Lord is my strength and my praise; and he is become my salvation.
With joy shall you draw waters out of the fountains of the Saviour.
And you shall say in that day: Give praise to the Lord, call upon his name.
Declare his works among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath done glorious things; let this be known in all the earth.
Cry out and shout, thou that dwellest in Sion: for the great one in the midst of thee is the Holy One of Israel.
